requirements.text: A petri net model has places
The Petri net package has a class Transition
The PetriNet package declares one Net class
An arc of a Petri net is associated with a weight.
A Petri net has place-transition arcs.
A Petri net is composed of transition-place arcs.
There are tokens in a Petri net.
Petri nets models have places, which are associated to exactly one net
A place has zero to n input arcs
In the PetriNet package, a Transition object belongs to at most one Net object
A transition of a Petri net has zero to n output arcs.
A Petri net is composed of at least one place.
A place-transition arc in a Petri net has exactly one transition representing the destination of the arc.
In a Petri net, a transition-place arc has exactly one transition acting as the source of the arc.
A token is associated with exactly one place of the Petri net.
